header.title: Colorado Storm · Connected Club Demo
header.subtitle: Best: connected club experience — simulated · Fall 2026 (Sep 6 – Nov 22). Explore how club-supplied teams, rosters and schedules could populate one parent view. Programs and venues are examples; recruiting sharing remains parent-controlled.

lockedInCard.heading: Locked In — Registration & Eligibility
lockedInCard.intro: Manage your player's registration requirements and approve what is shared with your club.
lockedInCard.simDisclaimer: Simulated statuses only. No real verification, payment or document integration is active in this demo.

statsTab.heading: Stats
statsTab.noStats: No games recorded yet. Open the Schedule tab, find a game and tap the + button to add stats.

mediaTab.heading: Media & Highlights
mediaTab.storageNote: Media is stored on this browser and device only. It may be cleared if you clear site data in your browser settings. No files are uploaded to a server in this demo.
mediaTab.addModalFileHint: JPEG, PNG or MP4 · stored on this device only
mediaTab.deleteConfirmNote: This removes the item and its file from this device. It cannot be undone.
mediaTab.unassignConfirmNote: This removes the item from this player's library. The original file is kept and still assigned to the owner.
mediaTab.emptyNote: Use the Add media button to log a photo, video or highlight clip. Items can be tagged to a specific game or left untagged.
mediaTab.shareNote: Media is private by default. Use the Share button on any item to share it.
mediaTab.simDisclaimer: Demo media library. Files are stored on this device only — no server upload.
mediaTab.collectionEmptyNote: No collections yet. Select highlight clips and create a named collection to share with coaches.

shareSheet.heading: Share
shareSheet.captionPlaceholder: Add a caption for this clip...
shareSheet.destInstagramNote: Open Instagram, tap + and select your downloaded file.
shareSheet.destFacebookNote: Open Facebook, tap Photo/Video and select your downloaded file.
shareSheet.destXNote: Open X, tap the compose button and attach your downloaded file.
shareSheet.collectionShareNote: This is a playlist — individual clips can be downloaded. A rendered reel is not available in this demo.
shareSheet.privateNote: Media is private by default. Sharing sends a file to your device for manual posting. No social account is connected and no post is made automatically.

newCollectionModal.heading: New highlight collection
newCollectionModal.noHighlights: No highlight clips yet. Add highlight clips in the media library first.
